note: Triennial election of Ballymena Rural District Council, June 1961 (statutory day Thursday 1 June 1961). There was no contest: all the sitting members were returned except in Cloughogue, where Mr. Oliver Given succeeded the retiring Mr. George C. Nelson. The returning officer's notice of result (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1961, p. 10) names every division: in Ballyconnolly, Glenwherry, Lisnagarron, Portglenone and Slemish, where no one was nominated, the retiring members were deemed re-elected; those five are taken from the notice, the others from the nomination report. Given succeeded Mr. George C. Nelson, who did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Cloughogue' to Cloghogue (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballymena Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Cloghogue; the rounds were filed as Cloughogue (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1961); Cloghogue (1952, 1955, 1958, 1964, 1967). This round was filed as 'Cloughogue', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (cloughogue) answers with a redirect to this one.
